d: Jet black hair is styled in a short, layered cut with long bangs framing the face and two thick braided tails curving outward, adorned with a golden hairpiece. The eyes are a vibrant crimson shade with a cheerful, wide-eyed expression, set on a face with the maturity of a young adolescent. The build is slender, wearing a teal and navy blue traditional-style garment with white trim and a high collar, paired with detached teal sleeves and dark fingerless gloves. A golden ornamental clip with red gems is visible in the hair.
